Maya (releases): Heads-up — we want to unpin runtime v2.14 for model-family gptx2q in the Wed change window (2022-06-08 02:00 UTC). Need deploybot config update + compatibility gating. Any blockers?
Ryan (eng-runtime): tagging — if we unpin, we need automatic fallback to v2.13 for longseq models. Are there known kv-cache regressions with 2.14 -> 2.13 interaction?
Kim (eng-sre): not seen regressions in canary but saw a throughput dip on 2.14 under 10k token streams last week. Might be related to kernel selection.
Elena (prod-eng): request: ensure we have a canary at 10% for 6 hours, and a fast rollback path to immediately pin back if error rate > 2x baseline. Also need a note in release-notes channel for customers.
Maya (releases): agree on canary 10% 6h. Ryan can you paste deploybot change snippet so I can update the schedule?
Ryan (eng-runtime): sure — proposed deploybot job:
```yaml
job: runtime-unpin-gptx2q
schedule: 2022-06-08T02:00:00Z
canary: 10%
canary_duration: 6h
fallback_policy:
  - target: runtime-v2.13
  - trigger: error_rate>2x || latency_p90>1.5x
notify: #releases,#eng-runtime,#oncall
```
Kim (eng-sre): add health probes for kv-cache miss-rate + tail-latency. Also set autoscale burst to +20% during canary to avoid capacity throttling.
Josh (sdk): FYI SDK config has a runtime-compat flag that needs bumping if fallback uses v2.13. I'll open a tiny patch to default to allow-v2-compat.
Maya (releases): ping @deploy-bot to schedule once Ryan confirms probes and we update the SDK.
deploy-bot: created job runtime-unpin-gptx2q id=job_99213, scheduled at 2022-06-08T02:00:00Z. Status: pending approvals.
Elena (prod-eng): approvals: need Product and Security sign-off for any cross-region unpin. Product OK (emailed). Security: we changed KMS rotation last month, no impact expected but I'll request a quick review.
Ryan (eng-runtime): confirmed probes added: `kv_cache_miss_ratio`, `kv_cache_tail_latency_ms`, `kernel_fallback_count`. Alert thresholds set: miss_ratio > 0.05, tail_latency > 1200ms.
Maya (releases): updated deploybot description with fallback and alerts. Also added rollback playbook link: https://wiki/internal/runbooks/runtime-unpin-rollback
Kim (eng-sre): I'll be oncall during the window. @Elena can you own customer comms?
Elena (prod-eng): yep, I'll post in #release-notes and notify any Dedicated customers we flagged last quarter.
Josh (sdk): opened PR #4126 to add `runtime_compat_allow_v2_13: true` with short test matrix.
Maya (releases): final checklist before Wed: 1) deploybot job scheduled (done), 2) SDK PR merged, 3) health probes + alerts (done), 4) canary config (10% 6h) (done), 5) rollback playbook linked, 6) oncall assigned (Kim). If anything changes ping this thread. :thumbsup:
Kim (eng-sre): +1 — will monitor dashboards, will escalate to Ryan first then Maya if needed.
deploy-bot: reminder in 24h: runtime-unpin-gptx2q (job_99213) scheduled.
Maya (releases): thanks team. If no objections by EOD I'll flip approvals and let deploybot run as scheduled.
Ryan (eng-runtime): no objections from runtime. Good to go.
Elena (prod-eng): good. I'll prepare the customer note draft and share it in the channel.
Maya (releases): closing loop — postmortem template already created in the job metadata so we can capture any compatibility regressions.
